stem: It ought to be surprising that the bank falsified the numbers on its accounts; it is truly shocking that such ____ was documented, in black and white, and that regulators found it and did nothing about it.

Because scientific breakthroughs tend to occur when a prevailing theory's predictions start to fail, scientists sometimes find it (i)____ when a theory persists—as the standard model of particle physics has done—in making (ii)____ predictions.
colsZh: 令人沮丧的；使人受挫的

stem: The chocolate company's scientists hoped that once they had (i)____ the chemical makeup of cocoa beans, the knowledge would enable them to produce (ii)____ the beans' taste, which could then be used to (iii)____ future failures in the cocoa bean supply.

Although Harman has not produced ____ biography of Robert Louis Stevenson, her understanding of what it takes to write a book enables her to account for Stevenson’s delirious sprints toward and away from publication.
optsZh: 确定的；权威的；结论性的

stem: Despite the ____ amount of high-quality data on the issue of underrepresentation of women professors in math-intensive fields, particularly in upper-level positions, myths and misunderstandings prevail.

An academic with a questionable record in either teaching, administration, or research may still be well regarded at many schools, but simultaneous failure in all three areas normally results in ____ by superiors.

The sleight of hand of architects whose ambition is to add subtly and seamlessly to early twentieth-century Beaux Arts buildings contradicts a first principle of historic preservation; the ____ historical periods should be clear.
